item.title: Dhaka garment maker Meridian Textiles wins $120 million export order
item.description: Dhaka-based garment maker Meridian Textiles has won a $120 million order from three European retailers, its largest export contract, and plans to add a new production line to meet it.

item.title: Employers rank data skills among top hiring priorities, survey finds
item.description: A survey of 500 employers by recruitment platform Talentbridge found that data analysis now ranks among the three most wanted skills, ahead of project management.

item.title: Chattogram food-delivery startup TiffinGo turns profitable in two years
item.description: TiffinGo, which delivers home-cooked lunches to office workers in Chattogram, says it reached profitability 24 months after launch by keeping a small network of home kitchens.

item.title: Pop star Lina Rae announces surprise world tour dates
item.description: Singer Lina Rae surprised fans by announcing a world tour, with ticket sales opening next week.
